app.name: Horizon
nav.label: Main
command.label: Command palette
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
home.title: Horizon is running
home.body: This is the skeleton: issues, projects and planning arrive in the next phases. Press {palette} for commands or {help} for shortcuts.
home.check.unreachable: The server did not answer the readiness check.
notFound.title: Page not found
field.name: Name
signIn.title: Sign in
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {email} belongs to an account, a link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Use at least {min} characters. A passphrase of a few words works well.
reset.done: Your password is set. You were signed out everywhere else.
account.title: Account
account.passwordLead: Changing it signs out your other sessions.
account.sessionsLead: Browsers where you are signed in. Sessions end after 30 days without use.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
error.network: Horizon can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match an account.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.version_conflict: Someone changed this in the meantime. The latest version is loaded; try again.
error.email.invalid: Enter an email address such as ada@example.com.
error.current_password.incorrect: This is not your current password.
error.timezone.unknown: Choose a time zone from the list.
error.token.invalid_or_expired: This link is invalid or has expired. Links work once, for one hour.
tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.lead: Personal access tokens let scripts and integrations call the API as you, sent as Authorization: Bearer. They act within your permissions and the scope you choose.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.namePlaceholder: What uses this token, e.g. CI pipeline
tokens.scopeHelp.read: Can read everything you can see, and change nothing.
tokens.scopeHelp.write: Can also create and change issues and everything else you may edit.
tokens.scopeHelp.admin: Can also administer workspaces you manage: members, roles, configuration. Use sparingly.
tokens.copyNow: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
tokens.revokeBody: Anything using “{name}” stops working at once. This can't be undone.
error.too_many_tokens: You have 50 tokens, the most allowed. Revoke unused ones first.
error.expires_at.past: Choose a date in the future.
home.noWorkspace: You're not in a workspace yet
home.noWorkspaceMember: Ask an administrator of your Horizon instance to invite you to a workspace.
home.noWorkspaceAdmin: Create the first workspace: a home for your projects, members and their settings.
home.slugHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It appears in every link to the workspace.
workspace.notFound: This workspace doesn't exist, or you're not a member.
workspace.empty: Projects and issues arrive here next. Meanwhile, invite the people you work with.
settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only workspace administrators can change these settings.
settings.slugHelp: Changing it breaks bookmarks and links shared outside Horizon.
settings.timeZoneHelp: Used for iteration dates and reports, unless a project sets its own.
members.note: Suspending keeps someone's issues and history but blocks their access to this workspace. Removing also takes them out of its teams.
members.suspendBody: They lose access to this workspace until reactivated. Their issues, teams and history stay, and their other workspaces are unaffected.
members.removeBody: They lose access and leave the workspace's teams. Their issues and history stay. They can be invited again.
members.revokeBody: The link in their email stops working.
invite.title: Invite people to {workspace}
invite.help: Each person gets an email with a link valid for 7 days.
teams.deleteBody: Its members stay in the workspace.
teams.name: Name
teams.noneBody: Teams group people so grants and assignments can target them together.
invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.otherAccount: You're signed in as {email}, but this invitation is for {invited}. Sign out, then open the link again.
invitation.signInFirst: You already have an account: sign in to accept.
error.invitation_invalid: This invitation link is invalid, already used, revoked or expired. Ask for a new one.
error.workspace_not_found: This workspace doesn't exist, or you're not a member.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
error.cannot_change_self: You can't do that to yourself.
error.email_mismatch: This invitation is for another email address.
error.member_not_found: That person is no longer a member.
error.insufficient_scope: This token's scope doesn't allow that.
error.session_required: Sign in with a browser to do that.
error.slug.invalid: Use 2–40 lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.
error.name.taken: A team already has this name.
error.time_zone.unknown: Choose a time zone from the list.
error.emails.too_many: Invite at most 50 people at once.
error.team_ids.unknown: One of these teams no longer exists.
roles.lead: Roles are defined for the whole workspace. A grant gives a role to a person or team on the workspace (every project) or on one project; their permissions add up.
roles.deleteBody: Only roles nobody holds can be deleted.
roles.name: Name
grants.subject: Person or team
grants.subjectPlaceholder: Choose a member or a team
grants.removeBody: Their other grants and their teams' still apply.
invite.defaultRole: They join as Contributor; workspace admins can change it afterwards.
perm.workspace.members.manage: Invite, suspend and remove members; teams
error.last_admin: The workspace needs at least one Admin on the whole workspace.
error.admin_keeps_roles_manage: The Admin role always keeps workspace.roles.manage.
error.admin_role_required: The Admin role can't be deleted.
error.role_in_use: Someone still holds this role. Change their grants first.
error.role_id.unknown: Choose a role of this workspace.
error.subject.unknown: That person or team is no longer in the workspace.
projects.name: Name
projects.keyHelp: 2–10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter. Issues are numbered after it: HZN-42.
projects.keyChange: Issues will be keyed {key}-… from now on. Links with {old}-… keep working.
projects.visibility.workspaceLong: Workspace — every member can view it
projects.visibility.privateLong: Private — only people and teams with a grant on {name}
projects.isArchived: This project is archived: read-only and hidden from the sidebar.
projects.archiveBody: Archiving makes {name} read-only and hides it from the sidebar; it can be restored. Archived projects can be deleted.
projects.restoreBody: {name} becomes editable and returns to the sidebar.
projects.deleteBody: Deleting {name} removes it with all its issues, their history and its configuration, for good. This can't be undone.
projects.readOnly: Only people with project.manage can change this project.
projects.noneCreate: Create the first project: it holds issues, boards and plans.
projects.noneMember: Projects you can see appear here.
projects.notFound: This project doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
error.project_not_found: This project doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
error.key.invalid: Use 2–10 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter.
error.key.taken: Another project uses or used this key.
error.lead_id.not_member: The lead must be a member of the workspace.
error.colour.invalid: Choose a colour from the list.
outcome.unstarted.help: Open. Counted as remaining scope; not yet work in progress.
outcome.started.help: Open. The first time an issue enters a started category marks when work began, for cycle time and cumulative flow.
outcome.completed.help: Final. The only outcome counted as delivered: velocity, burndown and release progress.
outcome.abandoned.help: Final. Closed and archived with the iteration, never counted as delivered.
categories.lead: Every status belongs to a category, and every category has an outcome. Reports, filters and iteration completion read the outcome, so projects can name their categories freely and still roll up together.
categories.name: Name

categories.deleteInUse.one: Statuses in {count} workflow use it. Choose a category with the same kind of outcome (open or final) to take them over; they move in one step.
categories.deleteInUse.other: Statuses in {count} workflows use it. Choose a category with the same kind of outcome (open or final) to take them over; they move in one step.

types.inheritedNote: Inherited types are edited in the workspace. To change one here, copy it to {project}; the original is switched off.
types.deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} issue type? Only types without issues can be deleted.
types.name: Name
types.workflowHelp: Changing it asks where each issue's status goes.
types.parentTypesHelp: Empty means any issue can be the parent.
types.mappingLead: The new workflow has other statuses. Choose where the issues of each status go; each records the change in its history.
workflows.deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} workflow? Only workflows no issue type uses can be deleted.
workflows.name: Name
workflows.categoriesNote: Categories and their outcomes come from Status categories. Board columns follow category order, then status order.
workflows.pickTransition: Select a transition in the matrix to name it and set its rules.
workflows.childrenFinal: All sub-issues are in a final category
workflows.conflict: Someone else saved this draft meanwhile; their version is loaded.
workflows.publishLead: {types} use this workflow. Publishing applies to every issue of those types at once.
workflows.publishLeadUnused: No issue type uses this workflow yet.

workflows.unmappedTitle.one: 1 issue is in a removed status

workflows.unmappedBody: Choose where they go. They move when you publish, and each records a status change in its history.
error.inherited_read_only: This comes from the workspace; edit it there, or copy it to the project.
error.not_inherited: Only inherited definitions can be switched off or copied.
error.category_in_use: A workflow used here has statuses in this category.
error.workflow_in_use: An issue type uses this workflow.
error.replacement_required: Statuses use this category: choose a replacement.
error.initial_status_in_category: A workflow's initial status is in this category, so it must stay open.
error.unmapped_statuses: Some issues need a new status first.
error.issue_type_not_found: That issue type no longer exists.
error.replacement.incompatible: Choose a category with the same kind of outcome.
error.parent_type_ids.unknown: One of these types isn't available here.
error.icon.invalid: Choose an icon from the list.
labels.hint: Labels from {name} can be switched off here; edit them in the workspace.
labels.label: Label
labels.note: Switching a label off hides it from pickers and filters in the project; issues keep it and show it greyed. Merging relabels every issue and records it in their history.
labels.name: Name

labels.mergeBody.one: {count} issue carrying {name} gets the chosen label instead, recorded in its history; then {name} is deleted.
labels.mergeBody.other: {count} issues carrying {name} get the chosen label instead, recorded in their history; then {name} is deleted.

estimation.workspaceUses: {name} uses {scale}. Switching this off returns {project} to it.
estimation.kindHelp.tshirt: XS to XL, weighted for velocity
estimation.changeNote: Changing the scale doesn't rewrite estimates: values outside the new scale are kept and flagged until someone re-estimates them.
estimation.label: Label
types.noFields: No custom field on this type.
types.requiredNote: Required fields are checked when an issue is created. To require one only on a transition, use a validator in the workflow.
fields.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? It leaves every issue type and workflow rule, and issues lose its values.
fields.typeFixed: A field's type can't change later.
error.into.unknown: Choose a label available everywhere this one is used.
error.fields.too_many: At most 50 fields per issue type.
